## CHAPTER XXX.

### On the Reign of the Sun.

Now you approach the end of your work, and you have almost completed your business; now everything appears like pure gold <note>original: *auri obryzi*; refers to gold that has been tested and refined by fire</note>, and the "virgin's milk" <note>an alchemical term for the mercurial liquid or white solvent used to moisten the material</note> with which you soak this matter becomes intensely yellow. Now return immortal thanks to God, the giver of all good things, who has led the work this far; pray to Him as a suppliant that He may guide your counsel from here on, lest by chance you lose everything by striving to rush a work that is already nearly finished. Consider now that you have waited for almost seven months, and it would not be sane to annihilate everything in a single hour. Therefore, be very cautious, and all the more so the closer you are to perfection. If you proceed cautiously, these notable things will occur: first, you will observe a certain yellow sweat on the body, and finally yellow vapors as the body settles, tinged with violet and sometimes with dark purple. After a wait of twelve or fourteen days in this "reign of the Sun" <note>The final stage of the process, associated with the achievement of the gold-colored Philosopher's Stone</note>, you will observe the matter to be for the most part moist, and although it is heavy, it is nevertheless in <meta>catchword: venti (the wind)</meta>

<summary>This page describes the final transition into the Reign of the Sun, characterized by a transformation of the matter into a deep yellow or gold color. The author emphasizes the need for patience and gratitude to God as the seven-month process nears its completion.</summary>
